title: 2015 AMC 10A Problem 7
statement: How many terms are in the arithmetic sequence \(13,\) \(16,\) \(19,\) \(\dotsc,\) \(70,\) \(73?\)

solutions.text:
Recall that the \(n\)th term of an arithmetic sequence is \(a + d(n - 1),\) where \(a\) is the first term and \(d\) is the common difference.

For us, \(a = 13\) and \(d = 3.\) Plugging these in, we get that \[\begin{aligned} 73 &= 13 + 3(n - 1) \\ 20&= n - 1 \\ n &= 21. \end{aligned}\] Thus, B is the correct answer.
